business_model.claim: Gold production volume depends on pit sequencing and pre-stripping (such as Phase 8 at Fekola), mine life transitions (such as the end of open pit mining at Otjikoto in 2025), and mine ramp-ups (such as Goose).

The production decrease was partially offset by the ramp up of Goose.

Third quarter of 2026 gold production is expected to be broadly in line with first quarter production levels, and fourth quarter of 2026 production is expected to be the strongest quarter of the year, driven by a full quarter of higher tonnes milled and strong mill feed grade.
